# Make targets

> Every `make` target in the Makefile — the ones `make help` lists, in its groups, then the rest — generated from the Makefile itself.

Descriptions come from the `help` rule's text. A target `make help` does not list falls back to the first sentence of the comment above its rule, else the first message it echoes. To document a target, add it to `make help`, then run `make docs`.

## 📊 IT-Journey Content Statistics

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `make stats` | Generate content statistics |
| `make stats-update` | Update statistics and show summary |
| `make stats-show` | Display current statistics |
| `make stats-clean` | Remove generated statistics file |
| `make stats-config` | Show current configuration |
| `make test` | Test the statistics generator |

## 🎯 Quest Tooling

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `make quest-validate` | Run quest_validator.py across pages/_quests |
| `make quest-network` | Validate quest dependency network (errors only) |
| `make quest-network-strict` | Network validation including orphan warnings (CI parity) |
| `make quest-build-network` | Rebuild quest-network.json / network.yml |
| `make quest-levels-data` | Emit _data/quests/levels.yml from registry |
| `make quest-nav` | Regenerate _data/navigation/quests.yml from collection |
| `make quest-data` | Regenerate all registry-derived quest data (levels, nav, network) (runs `quest-levels-data`, `quest-nav`, `quest-build-network`) |
| `make quest-audit` | Unified audit: content + network + data freshness (one report) |
| `make quest-audit-strict` | Unified audit with warnings escalated to failures |
| `make quest-audit-report` | Unified audit + JSON report (quest-audit-report.json) |
| `make quest-skills` | Regenerate the character-skill roadmap blocks (.claude/skills/quest-character-*) |
| `make quest-skills-check` | Verify character skills match paths.yml + the registry |

## 🐳 Dockerized Validation (CI-parity, no host Ruby/Python)

| --- | --- |
| `make docker-validate` | Run the unified quest audit in Docker (python:3.12-slim) |
| `make docker-validate-strict` | Dockerized audit with warnings as failures |
